notes.subject: sukoro
notes.rationale: קרחה baldness is the sign of mourning; rendered plainly as 'baldness', not 'mourning'

notes.subject: u ka dugubon
notes.rationale: עמקם 'their valley': singular (Ashkelon's valley, KJV) vs 'their valleys' (Geneva); kept singular

notes.subject: tɔɔrɔden
notes.rationale: שארית read as vocative 'O remnant' (YLt/BSB) or as apposition to Ashkelon; kept ambiguous as apposition

notes.subject: tɔɔrɔden
notes.rationale: the question 'how long wilt thou gash thyself' directly addresses the remnant of the Philistine valley

translation: Sukoro na Aza (Gazɛ) kan; Ashkelon banna, u ka dugubon tɔɔrɔden; fo jumɛ i bɛna i yɛrɛ gɛ?
